Circular on Test Report Templates

Published Date
30 September 2026
Circular No.
CMI 05/2026

This circular informs licensed test entities of the publication of new report templates.

Requirements

  • Entities must submit the misconduct report within 14 days of the misconduct being discovered.
  • Entities must retain records of each report for at least 5 years.
